description.from: **Milestone:** M1, first slice **Goal.** As an operator, I get a readable HTML and plain-text email with no pixel and no rewritten link. **Build.** - `src/caducus/notify/channels/email.py`, `src/caducus/notify/render/operator.py`, `handlers/email_sender.py`, SQS `caducus-email` with a dead-letter queue. - Ported from Papyrus `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/worker.py`: claim the row with `attribute_not_exists` before calling SES, so a retry cannot double-send; throttled calls back off 1, 2, 4 seconds; space calls to `MaxSendRate` from `sesv2 get_account`, cached. - Render: inline styles, links always underlined, state in words and a mark (`ALARM`, `CLEARED`), never colour alone. Escape everything. The themed renderer comes in T_RENDER; this template must not need Markus. - Message tags: `delivery`, `kind`. **Acceptance.** Rendered samples checked by test for no `` pixel, no tracking host, a text part and the state as a word. **Depends on:** kanbus-ad0a0d, kanbus-236f63 **Specification.** ```gherkin Feature: Email channel Scenario: An email goes out once Given a queued email delivery When the sender handles it twice Then SES was called once And the log shows "sent" with the provider id Scenario: SES throttles Given SES answers with a throttling error When the sender handles a delivery Then it retries with backoff and the delivery is still sent once Scenario: Nothing in the mail tracks the reader When any notification email is rendered Then it has no tracking image and every link points at its real destination ```
